title: Dowry vs Alimony...
description:
Social media par ek simple sa narrative chal raha hai — “Dowry aur alimony dono hi equally galat hain.” Par kya sach me ye dono same cheez hain? Ya hum ek dangerous oversimplification kar rahe hain?

Is video me main detail me baat karta hoon dowry ke reality par — jo aaj bhi gaon se leke metro cities tak openly chal rahi hai — aur alimony ke law par, jo ek legal support system ke roop me banaya gaya tha. Saath hi, hum un cases ko bhi ignore nahi karte jahan alimony aur 498A ka misuse extortion ka tool ban chuka hai, jisse lakhon men aur unki families mental torture face kar rahi hain.

Yaha na blind feminism hai, na blind men’s rights — sirf facts, cases, court observations, aur ek honest attempt to separate social evil from legal misuse.

Is video ka goal shout karna nahi, samajhna hai.
Watch till the end before forming an opinion.
